If you want one high-quality, versatile shaper, I’d point you to SPANXshape® Invisible Mid-Thigh Short. 🖤

It’s a great fit because it gives medium shaping with lightweight, breathable fabric, so it smooths without feeling stiff or heavy. It also has 360-degree shaping, a no-squeeze waistband to help prevent rolling, and free-cut leg openings so it stays discreet under clothes. It’s also designed to help with thigh chafing, which makes it especially good for all-day wear.

If you want, send me your usual dress or pants size, and I’ll recommend the best size to start with.
